title: a project without .agents/instructions loads its catalog: the folder only feeds the optional route_scope ids
source: intended: route_scope is optional (docs/decisions.md, the QA vocabulary row); found by the first real jitso init in a fresh repo (2026-11-23)
intent: INTENDED behavior. `.agents/instructions/agent-*.md` only gives the ids a build's optional route_scope may name. A project that has no such folder (any project that is not one of the boilerplates) has no route ids, and every command that loads the catalog works: build list exits 0 and doctor's catalog check is ok. Before, the missing folder failed the catalog with `open .agents/instructions: no such file or directory`. The fixture's builds name route_scope ids, so the case drops them too: a build that names an id still fails, as it should.
